lines.text: Give thanks to the LORD, call upon His name;
make known His deeds among the nations.
Sing to Him, sing praises to Him;
tell of all His wonders.
Glory in His holy name;
let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
Seek out the LORD and His strength;
seek His face always.
Remember the wonders He has done,
His marvels, and the judgments He has pronounced,
O offspring of His servant Abraham,
O sons of Jacob, His chosen ones.
He is the LORD our God;
His judgments carry throughout the earth.
He remembers His covenant forever,
the word He ordained for a thousand generations—
the covenant He made with Abraham,
and the oath He swore to Isaac.
He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree,
to Israel as an everlasting covenant:
“I will give you the land of Canaan
as the portion of your inheritance.”

pictures.scene: Juan Bautista Maíno, Pentecost — the tongues of fire coming down on the gathered company who will carry the name out, make known His deeds among the nations
pictures.name: pd_maino_volken

pictures.scene: Caravaggio, Rest on the Flight into Egypt — old Joseph holding up the music book with both hands for the playing to go on, sing to Him, sing praises to Him
pictures.name: pd_caravaggio_zing

pictures.scene: Fritz von Uhde, Das Tischgebet — Christ come in at the door of a poor cottage and the children with folded hands at the table, let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice
pictures.name: pd_uhde_verheug

pictures.scene: Sinai Christ Pantocrator — the face itself, the blessing hand and the gospel book, seek His face always
pictures.name: pd_sinai_aangezicht

pictures.scene: Giuseppe Angeli, Elijah Taken Up in a Chariot of Fire — Elisha with both arms flung up under the white horses and the flame, remember the wonders He has done
pictures.name: pd_angeli_wonderen

pictures.scene: After Peter Paul Rubens, The Reconciliation of Jacob and Esau — the two brothers taking each other by the hand at the meeting, O sons of Jacob, His chosen ones
pictures.name: pd_rubens_nageslacht

pictures.scene: Isaac Levitan, Above Eternal Peace — the little church and the grave crosses on the headland under an immense sky, His judgments carry throughout the earth
pictures.name: pd_levitan_oordeel

pictures.scene: Edward Hicks, Peaceable Kingdom — the child with his hand on the lion's mane and the calf, lamb and leopard lying down together, the word He ordained for a thousand generations
pictures.name: pd_hicks_verbond

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Abraham's Sacrifice — the angel come down with his hand raised and the knife falling away through the air, the oath He swore to Isaac
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_eed

pictures.scene: José de Ribera, Jacob's Dream — Jacob asleep on the bare ground with the light broken open above him, He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree
pictures.name: pd_ribera_besluit

pictures.scene: Jasper Francis Cropsey, Autumn — On the Hudson River — the whole valley and its water lying open under the sun breaking through, as the portion of your inheritance
pictures.name: pd_cropsey_erfdeel
